function.arguments:
{"script": "cd /home/user && python3 << 'ENDSCRIPT'
import FreeCAD
from FreeCAD import Base
import Part
import math

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Document opened successfully")

# Get the bounding box of the Body to determine stock size
body_obj = doc.getObject('Body')
if body_obj and body_obj.Shape:
    bbox = body_obj.Shape.BoundBox
    print(f"Part bounding box: ({bbox.XMin:.2f}, {bbox.YMin:.2f}, {bbox.ZMin:.2f}) to ({bbox.XMax:.2f}, {bbox.YMax:.2f}, {bbox.ZMax:.2f})")
    
    # Add some margin for stock (5mm on each side)
    margin = 5.0
    stock_length = bbox.XMax - bbox.XMin + 2 * margin  # X dimension
    stock_width = bbox.YMax - bbox.YMin + 2 * margin   # Y dimension  
    stock_height = bbox.ZMax - bbox.ZMin + 2 * margin  # Z dimension
    
    # Position stock centered around the part
    stock_x_offset = bbox.XMin - margin
    stock_y_offset = bbox.YMin - margin
    stock_z_offset = bbox.ZMin - margin
    
    print(f"Stock dimensions: {stock_length} x {stock_width} x {stock_height}")
    print(f"Stock position offset: ({stock_x_offset}, {stock_y_offset}, {stock_z_offset})")

# Create a Stock object (a solid block for material)
stock_shape = Part.makeBox(stock_length, stock_width, stock_height)
stock_placement = Base.Placement(Base.Vector(stock_x_offset, stock_y_offset, stock_z_offset), Base.Rotation())
stock_shape.Placement = stock_placement

# Create a Part::Feature for the stock
stock_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Stock")
stock_obj.Shape = stock_shape
stock_obj.Label = "Stock"

# Create a group for CAM operations if needed
cam_group = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", "CAM_Setup")
cam_group.Label = "CAM Setup"

print(f"Created Stock object: {stock_obj.Name}")
print(f"Created CAM group: {cam_group.Name}")

# Recompute
doc.recompute()
print("Document recomputed successfully")

# Save to verify
doc.saveAs("/home/user/test_stock.FCStd")
print("Test file saved")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
ENDSCRIPT"}
